aboutText: Located in the vibrant heart of Oradea, Hotel Maxim is more than just a place to stay – it's a destination. We have created a space where timeless elegance meets modern comfort, offering our guests an unforgettable experience. Every detail, from the refined interior design to the personalized services, is designed to exceed your expectations and turn every stay into a precious memory.

termsAcceptance: By using the site and/or submitting a booking request, you confirm that you have read and accept this document.
termsSection1Title: 1) Purpose of the Site. General Information
termsSection1Content:
The site presents the services offered by Hotel Maxim (accommodation, restaurant & bar, wellness, meeting/conference rooms) and allows the submission of booking requests/offers.

S.C. MAXIM S.A. reserves the right to update the information on the site, including commercial and operational policies, without prior notice.
termsSection2Content:
2.1 How to Book

Bookings can be submitted through the forms available on the site or by direct contact (phone/e-mail). The booking confirmation is sent by the hotel, depending on availability.

2.2 Data Required at Check-in

Accommodation is provided by filling out the arrival notification form, based on the identity document, in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

2.3 Arrivals & Departures

  • Check-in: starting from 14:00
  • Check-out: until 12:00
  • Late check-out: possible depending on availability, with a fee applicable according to hotel practice.
termsSection3Content:
3.1 Rates displayed on the site (RON/night)

Accommodation rates are expressed in RON/night. VAT is included in the room rate.

  • Standard Single – 300 RON
  • Deluxe Single – 330 RON
  • Standard Double – 390 RON
  • Deluxe Double – 420 RON
  • Triple (Deluxe) – 550 RON
  • Apartment – 500–550 RON

3.2 Local tax / tourist promotion tax – 3%

A local tax of 3% is applied to the rates above. This is paid separately. According to local regulations, the tourist promotion tax is calculated by applying a rate of 3% to the accommodation rate exclusive of VAT, and is collected by the accommodation unit.

3.3 What is included in the accommodation rate

Standard rates include (where mentioned on the site): internet, parking (subject to availability), access to the fitness room, and access to the swimming pool.

3.4 Rate Adjustments

Depending on the occupancy rate and the type of request (leisure, corporate, events), the hotel may apply different rates/commercial conditions, communicated in the offer/confirmation sent to the client.
termsSection4Content:
Accepted methods: cash (RON), card (Visa/Mastercard/Maestro/American Express), and bank transfer.

Payment rules:

  • payment is made in advance or within a maximum of 3 days of accommodation;
  • for long-stays, payment is made in advance or every 3 days;
  • for phone/fax bookings without card details, an advance payment may be required to guarantee the booking.
termsSection5Content:
Cancellations are made by contacting the reception.

  • Bookings up to 2 rooms: no penalty if cancellation is made at least 3 days in advance; otherwise, the penalty may be the equivalent of the first night.
  • Bookings of 2+ rooms: cancellation must be made at least 10 days before the arrival date.
  • Groups: conditions are communicated on request, depending on the number of rooms/services.
termsSection6Title: 6) Policy for Children and Extra Beds
termsSection6Content:
• Children up to 7 years: free accommodation and breakfast.
  • Children 7–14 years: free accommodation; breakfast 30 RON/child.
  • Over 14 years: considered adults.

Extra beds:

  • extra bed for children under 2 years: 70 RON
  • normal extra bed: 90 RON
termsSection7Content:
7.1 Visitors

Visitors in the room between 08:00–22:00, at no extra cost. Between 22:00–08:00, visitors must be registered at the reception and may pay the rate difference, according to hotel rules.

7.2 Pets

General rule: accommodation with animals/birds is not allowed. Exceptions: only with the hotel's consent and with sanitary/vaccination documents; a fee may apply (mentioned as 50% of the value charged for one person).
termsSection8Content:
The hotel uses electronic systems to monitor access; public spaces are under video surveillance. It is recommended to use the in-room safe to store valuables.

Parking is available for free, subject to availability, without dedicated security; it is recommended to avoid leaving items in plain sight.

The hotel's liability does not extend to vehicles or their contents.
termsSection9Content: The hotel reserves the right to refuse accommodation/service in the restaurant in situations that affect the safety, order, or comfort of other guests or the image of the unit.
termsSection10Content: The processing of personal data (e.g., name, phone, e-mail, booking data) is done for the administration of bookings and hotel services. Full details are available in the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy published on the site.
termsSection11Content: For accommodation services on a specific date/period, the legislation provides exceptions to the right of withdrawal (14 days) applicable to other distance contracts.
termsSection12Content: Any complaint is first sent to the Hotel (phone/e-mail). Consumers can use the Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) mechanisms through ANPC. The European ODR platform was closed starting July 20, 2025.
termsSection13Content: Any dispute will be settled amicably; in the absence of a solution, the dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bihor.
